title: ZCode installation documentation entered the development record
summary: On 2026-06-15, the sealed ZCode IDE development record included Z.ai's English ZCode installation documentation. Its install-focused official URL makes this a material onboarding milestone for the ZCode 3.0 line. The supplied evidence does not establish the product release details, supported platforms, or whether the guide itself was first published that day.
